description: This file contains a class 'Topic' which is a controller for managing a 'Topic' module in the OpenCart admin interface. It includes methods for rendering the module configuration page ('index') and saving configuration settings ('save').

classes.name: Topic
classes.description: Controller class for managing the Topic module in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the configuration page for the Topic module, setting up page data such as breadcrumbs, header, footer, and module status.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the module settings with permission checks and returns success or error messages in JSON format.
